Corte de combustible de emergencia

A safety device or procedure for rapidly stopping fuel supply to machinery or tanks in case of fire or other emergencies.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Corte de combustible de emergencia?

In this glossary, Corte de combustible de emergencia refers to: A safety device or procedure for rapidly stopping fuel supply to machinery or tanks in case of fire or other emergencies.

How is Corte de combustible de emergencia used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Active el corte de combustible de emergencia inmediatamente en caso de incendio o fuga de combustible en la sala de máquinas."

Why does Corte de combustible de emergencia matter in maritime?

Corte de combustible de emergencia matters because it supports clear communication in Engineering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Corte de combustible de emergencia?

Corte de combustible de emergencia is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

Definition

A safety device or procedure for rapidly stopping fuel supply to machinery or tanks in case of fire or other emergencies.

Operational example

Activate the emergency fuel cutoff immediately in case of fire or fuel leak in the engine room.

Localized term

Corte de combustible de emergencia

Localized example

Active el corte de combustible de emergencia inmediatamente en caso de incendio o fuga de combustible en la sala de máquinas.
